entities.summary: The Odesa Numismatics Museum is a currency museum in Ukraine. The museum preserves and exhibits ancient relics from the Northern Black Sea Region and Rus-Ukraine. Odesa Numismatics Museum is a museum in Europe, established in 1999. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
